# [TASK] Implement API Gateway (Spring Cloud Gateway)

## Task
Spring Cloud Gateway as the single entry point. Routes to every backend
service, with JSON Web Token authentication, rate limiting, circuit breaking
and cross-origin resource sharing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The gateway listens on 8080 and routes to the backend services
      (`MovieServiceContractTest`, `UserServiceContractTest`,
      `ActorServiceContractTest`, `AiServiceContractTest`)
- [x] The JSON Web Token filter rejects an expired or malformed token with 401
      (`JwtUtilTest`, `JwtAuthenticationFilter`)
- [x] Redis-backed rate limiting is applied on the routes
      (`RateLimitConfigTest`; four `RequestRateLimiter` filters in
      `backend/api-gateway/src/main/resources/application.yml`)
- [x] A downstream failure returns the fallback rather than propagating
      (`FallbackControllerTest`, `GlobalErrorWebExceptionHandlerTest`)
- [x] The context loads and the Dockerfile builds
      (`ApiGatewayApplicationTests`,
      `docker build -f backend/api-gateway/Dockerfile .`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 8

## Notes
Implemented 2025-11-15 and 16: module in `184d2f2`, routing, JSON Web Token
handling, rate limiting and the circuit breaker in `0fe3f1f` and `e5e41c7`.

The gateway has grown well past this slice since, with the TMDB facade and
auth proxy routes and further hardening. Those belong to their own issues.
